title: Role Definition (Org Kernel — schema_version 1)
description: Domain-neutral schema for org/roles/<role_id>.yaml. The org kernel is substrate-agnostic per GP-191; this schema defines structural invariants only. Domain-specific extensions (e.g., ZTARE research_taste_axes) layer on top via per-adapter extension schemas, NOT by modifying this file.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment when breaking changes are made; ship a v2 schema file alongside.

role_id.description: Stable kebab/snake_case identifier. Must match the file name (org/roles/<role_id>.yaml).

role_class.description: Role family. Kernel-defined enum; new families require a kernel revision (and a v2 schema). 'authority' is the ultimate-decision role (typically held by the principal); 'principal' is reserved for compatibility but the canonical class for the human owner is 'authority'. The distinction lets a future deployment have a non-human authority (e.g., a board, a regulator) without renaming the principal role file.

description.description: Prose description of what this role exists to do. Used by the role-card export and the bootstrap prompt's role context.

authorized_paths.description: Repo-relative glob patterns the role may write to. Empty list means read-only (paired with forbidden_paths: ['*']).

forbidden_paths.description: Repo-relative glob patterns the role must never write to. Hard veto. ['*'] makes the role read-only globally.

delegates_to.description: Identifiers of sub-agents or peer roles this role may invoke. Use 'worker.<name>' for ephemeral workers and 'role.<name>' for peer roles.

escalates_to.description: Identifiers of roles that receive escalations. 'role.principal' is the universal escalation target.

budget.description: Spend caps in USD. null on any field means 'no cap enforced for this role' — reserved for role_class=authority (e.g., principal), since the authority approves its own spend. All other role classes SHOULD set numeric caps; the schema does not enforce this conditionally because the kernel must remain domain-neutral.

daily_cap_usd.description: Max USD spend per UTC day across all sessions for this role. null = unbounded (authority-only).

session_cap_usd.description: Max USD spend within a single session. null = unbounded (authority-only).

single_action_cap_usd.description: Max USD spend on a single agent CLI invocation. null = unbounded (authority-only).

warn_threshold_frac.description: Fraction of any cap (e.g., 0.80) that triggers a warning push. null = no early-warning (authority-only).

absolute_ceiling_usd.description: Hard ceiling that overrides daily_cap. null = no hard ceiling (authority-only).

agent_rotation.description: Optional agent-CLI rotation policy (gp168 v3 run-2 finding F3, 2026-05-02). Rotates the role's primary member across multiple agent CLIs (Claude / Codex / Gemini) on a fixed cadence, forcing role behavior to be CLI-invariant. Single-CLI-specific gaming patterns surface as cross-CLI inconsistency in role outputs. Absent block → no rotation (legacy single-member binding).

rotation_period_days.description: How often to swap primary member. Typical: 7 (weekly) for production, 1 (daily) for stress-test.

members.description: Ordered list of member identifiers in the rotation. Minimum 2 members; must include 'member.' prefix.

strategy.description: round_robin: cycle through members in order. random: uniform random per period (seeded by date). stratified: weighted by past CLI-specific gaming-incident count.

fallback_member.description: Member to use when rotation cannot proceed (e.g., a CLI is unavailable). Required if any member in the rotation list could be unavailable.

agent_utilization.description: Optional agent-CLI utilization caps (capacity dimension, separate from USD spend). Tracks Claude-Code / Codex / Gemini-CLI session-window usage per role per UTC day. Consumed by src/ztare/supervisor/agent_utilization_tracker.py. Warn-threshold trip emits a Telegram push (GP-128b) AND a damage signal at org/signals/damage/. Absent block → module defaults apply (3h/day, 500k tokens, 200 turns). Warn threshold is jittered by ±10% per (role, agent_cli, UTC-date) for detection-independent gaming defense (gp168 v3 run-2 finding F2, 2026-05-02).

daily_cap_seconds.description: Max wall-clock seconds of agent-CLI session time per UTC day.

daily_cap_output_tokens.description: Max output tokens emitted by the agent CLI per UTC day.

daily_cap_turn_count.description: Max agent steps (turns) per UTC day.

session_cap_seconds.description: Max wall-clock seconds for any single agent-CLI session.

warn_threshold_frac.description: Push a warning when any cap reaches this fraction (e.g. 0.80).

mandate_path.description: Repo-relative path to the role's mandate. null means 'no dedicated mandate; the role is wrapper-invoked or read-only and the role yaml is the only authorization contract' — see the comment in the yaml file for the rationale.

response_time_inbox_hours.description: Target response time for non-urgent inbox items, in hours. null means no SLA (typical for escalator-only roles like principal/manager when at the top of the chain).

response_time_urgent_hours.description: Target response time for urgent items. null means no SLA.

failure_mode.description: Free-form documentation of behavior when the role is unavailable or crashes. Used by ops runbooks; not enforced by code.

signs_gates.description: Names of gate types this role is authorized to co-sign. Empty list means the role gives opinions, not signatures.

opened_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the role yaml was first authored.

opened_by.description: Identifier of the principal or agent that authored this role yaml.
